en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of an old, narrow courtyard or alleyway flanked by multi-story buildings with timber-framed upper levels and brick or stone lower levels. There are a few people, including children, standing on a staircase leading to a doorway. The architecture appears Northern European, with steep tiled roofs and multi-paned windows. The lower right corner contains a logo and the text 'ARBEJDERMUSEET'.
